rules.title: Boundary naming: make domain edges explicit
rules.preview: Label module boundaries in complex systems to keep responsibilities clear.

rules.title: Connection style: bidirectional request/response
rules.preview: Use bidirectional semantics for request-response relationships to reduce ambiguity.

rules.title: Hierarchy depth: default to three layers
rules.preview: Use presentation, logic, and data layers as the preferred architecture skeleton.

rules.title: Naming preference: User over Client
rules.preview: Prefer User as the primary actor name in system diagrams.

rules.title: Annotation placement: quiet bottom-right notes
rules.preview: Keep notes below the main flow hierarchy so they do not steal focus.

rules.title: Geometry: 12px corner radius
rules.preview: Keep cards and nodes on a consistent radius for a calmer visual system.

rules.title: Line baseline: 1.5px
rules.preview: Use 1.5px strokes in dense diagrams to balance sharpness and readability.

rules.title: Primary palette: blue-violet gradient
rules.preview: Use brand blue-violet on core nodes and avoid high-saturation red unless needed.
